answer: Anti-sybil: time-locked stake bond with ASN diversity gating. Every identity locks 250 POA into a contract that releases only after the epoch's beacon hash is published, so the bond cannot be withdrawn mid-attack. The node records each identity's ASN and refuses issuance when two identities share one ASN within 72 hours. Attestation from a mismatched subnet triggers slashing and the bond burns. Cost for 1,000 clones: 250,000 POA locked 60 days plus 1,000 distinct ASNs, about 4,000 dollars monthly. Each new thread of identity is a relic of capital the haven never refunds.
